description: This Java source file defines the GestureTypingDetector class, which is responsible for detecting gesture-based typing patterns, generating gesture paths, and suggesting candidate words based on user input gestures. It includes methods for managing gesture points, generating gesture path corners, and calculating distances between user gestures and candidate words.

classes.name: GestureTypingDetector
classes.description: Main class responsible for detecting gesture typing, managing gesture points, generating gesture paths, and providing word suggestions based on gesture input.

classes.name: GestureTypingDetector.WorkspaceData
classes.description: Helper class for managing gesture workspace data, including gesture points and maxima points for curvature detection.

classes.name: GestureTypingDetector.CornersGenerationData
classes.description: Helper class used during background corner generation, encapsulating data needed for generating gesture path corners.

methods.name: GestureTypingDetector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the detector with configuration parameters and the set of keyboard keys.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns an observable stream of the current loading state of gesture data.

methods.name: setWords
methods.description: Sets the list of words and their frequencies for gesture recognition and triggers background corner generation.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Disposes resources and resets the detector state.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a new gesture point if it is sufficiently distant from the previous point, returning the squared distance.

methods.name: getCandidates
methods.description: Returns a list of candidate words based on the current gesture path.
